en: Psalms 103
By David.

p.src: 1  Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

ja: をほめたたえよ。 私の
にあるすべてのものよ、その
en: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

p.src: 2  Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

ja: をほめたたえよ。 主が与えてくださったすべての
en: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
u.src: 2  Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

p.src: 3  who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

ja: し、 あなたのすべての
en: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
u.src: 3  who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

p.src: 4  who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

en: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
u.src: 4  who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

p.src: 5  who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

en: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
u.src: 5  who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

p.src: 6  The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

ja: げられているすべての者のために、
en: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
u.src: 6  The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

p.src: 7  He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

ja: をモーセに、 御業をイスラエルの
en: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
u.src: 7  He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

p.src: 8  The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

en: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
u.src: 8  The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

p.src: 9  He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

en: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
u.src: 9  He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

p.src: 10  He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

en: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
u.src: 10  He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

p.src: 11  For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

ja: いように、 主を恐れる者たちへの
en: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
u.src: 11  For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

p.src: 12  As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

en: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
u.src: 12  As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

p.src: 13  Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

en: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
u.src: 13  Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

p.src: 14  For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

ja: たちがちりにすぎないことを
en: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
u.src: 14  For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

p.src: 15  As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

en: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
u.src: 15  As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

p.src: 16  For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

ja: も、もはや花を覚えていない。
en: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
u.src: 16  For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

p.src: 17  But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

ja: しかし、主を恐れる者たちへの
しみは、とこしえからとこしえまで続き、 その
en: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
u.src: 17  But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

p.src: 18  to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

ja: る者たち、 その命令を覚えて
en: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
u.src: 18  to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

p.src: 19  The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

ja: を堅く立てられた。 その
en: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
u.src: 19  The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

p.src: 20  Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

ja: をほめたたえよ。 力に満ち、その御言葉を行い、 その御言葉の声に聞き従う者たちよ。
en: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
u.src: 20  Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

p.src: 21  Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

ja: をほめたたえよ。 御心を行う、主のしもべたちよ。
en: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
u.src: 21  Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

p.src: 22  Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!

ja: られたすべてのものよ、
をほめたたえよ。 主が治めるすべての所で。 私の
en: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!
u.src: 22  Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!
